name: Runemaster Sigilist extends crowd control after a Palm Sigil and speeds up Palm Sigils (#1340)
contract: Sigilist 705586 (Runic talent, passive): 'After using a Palm Sigil, the duration of your crowd control effects
is increased by $706525s1%. Reduces the cast time of all Palm Sigils by $/1000;S2 sec and increases the duration
of your Palm Sigil buffs by $s3%.' Effect 1 is a native flat SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME -500 and effect 2 a native
percent SPELLMOD_DURATION +50, both on family 38 mask2 0x2000, which every player Palm Sigil carries (Earth
805382: 1500 ms cast, 6 sec aura). Effect 0 is aura 42 naming 706525, a 5 sec self buff whose effect 0 is a
percent SPELLMOD_DURATION +20 on the crowd control masks (mask0 0x1800082 includes Palm Sigil: Earth's stun
807824, mask0 0x80). Its EffectSpellClassMask (mask0 0x4) names Runic Tattoos, which 3.3.5 proc auras do not
read; the tooltip names Palm Sigils. Spell.dbc gives 705586 ProcFlags 0, so SpellMgr generated no proc entry
and effect 0 never fired. Expected: the cast time and aura duration changes already hold; casting a Palm Sigil
applies 706525 for 5 sec, during which the stun lasts 1.2 times as long, and a player without the talent gets
neither. Palm Sigils require the 'Runeshroud or Waveforged' marker 808089, granted here through Runeshroud.

steps.label: SETUP: Runeshroud grants the Palm Sigil marker
SETUP: the control has the Palm Sigil marker
Sigilist reduces the Palm Sigil cast time by 0.5 sec
Without the talent Palm Sigil takes 1.5 sec
Before a Palm Sigil the stun duration is unmodified
SETUP: Palm Sigil: Earth is cast
Sigilist extends the Palm Sigil buff by 50%
Using a Palm Sigil grants Sigilist's crowd control buff
The crowd control buff lasts 5 sec
The buff lengthens crowd control by 20%
SETUP: the control casts Palm Sigil: Earth
Without the talent the Palm Sigil buff keeps 6 sec
Without the talent a Palm Sigil grants no crowd control buff
Crowd control returns to its normal duration
